description: Phase-1.5 realism check: distribution of the classifier's P(fibrotic) output on the labeled synthetic validation set (split by truth class) beside its output on unlabeled in-vivo IAFDB traces. The synthetic panel shows the healthy/fibrotic separation the model learned; the IAFDB panel shows whether that separation survives on real signals or collapses toward an over-confident peak. Renders via the 'prediction-histogram' recipe in panels mode.
